databases.name: Query Cosmic
databases.description: Query COSMIC (Catalogue of Somatic Mutations in Cancer) database for somatic mutations, Cancer Gene Census, mutational signatures, and gene fusions in cancer research.
databases.help_text: Requires COSMIC account (free for academic users). Register at https://cancer.sanger.ac.uk/cosmic/register
databases.scientific_context: Cancer genomics, precision oncology, somatic mutation analysis, drug resistance research

databases.name: Query ClinPGx
databases.description: Query ClinPGx database for pharmacogenomics annotations linking genetic variants to drug response phenotypes.
databases.help_text: No authentication required. Data from PharmGKB and CPIC guidelines.
databases.scientific_context: Pharmacogenomics, drug metabolism, personalized medicine, clinical genetics

databases.name: Query USPTO
databases.description: Search USPTO patent database for chemical compounds, drug patents, and biotechnology intellectual property.
databases.help_text: Uses USPTO Open Data Portal API. No authentication required for basic queries.
databases.scientific_context: Drug discovery, intellectual property, freedom-to-operate analysis, competitive intelligence

databases.name: Query ZINC
databases.description: Query ZINC database of commercially available compounds for virtual screening and drug discovery.
databases.help_text: Access 750M+ purchasable compounds. Subset downloads available without authentication.
databases.scientific_context: Virtual screening, lead discovery, compound libraries, drug-like properties
